title: Mass bound |X(η)| ≤ M_V(X)·C for test forms with Euclidean coefficient norm ≤ C
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, U, V ⊆ ℝ^P arbitrary sets, X ∈ D_k(U) a current (GeometricCurrentOn U k), η ∈ D^k(U) a test form (TestFormOn U k) and C ∈ ℝ with C > 0, tsupport η ⊆ V and covectorEuclideanNorm(η(x)) ≤ C for every x ∈ ℝ^P. Then ENNReal.ofReal |X(η)| ≤ M_V(X) · ENNReal.ofReal C in [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (V : Set (Eucl P)) (η : TestFormOn U k) (C : ℝ), 0 < C → tsupport (η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) ⊆ V → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((η : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) k) x) ≤ C) → ENNReal.ofReal |X η| ≤ X.massOn V * ENNReal.ofReal C
